observations.observation: At 04:48:04Z on October 7, the feed carried Bloomberg’s 04:32Z headline that Intel would keep working on Terafab. The interview or statement time is not specified in the pre-cutoff feed record. The retrieved article copy attributes the statement to Lip-Bu Tan, but the full-body pre-cutoff snapshot was not verified.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The verified pre-cutoff record establishes continuity wording, not the scope, timing, quantity, or binding status of any production commitment. TSMC discussions had been publicly reported earlier.

observations.observation: On April 7, Intel publicly joined the Terafab project; contemporaneous coverage described the announced contribution as helping refactor chip-factory technology.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The cited announcement did not give production quantities or a binding production order.

observations.observation: On October 3, an independent report said Musk confirmed TSMC–Terafab discussions, while describing them as discussions rather than an announced agreement.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: This raised a possible alternative or additional relationship but did not establish an agreed TSMC role or Intel’s removal.

gaps: The direct Bloomberg page was not retrievable, and no dated archive of its full October 7 article body was verified before the cutoff. The feed-captured title and publication time are available; the interview time and full-body revision history remain unknown.
No independently authored report of Tan’s October 7 statement was verified as published by 04:49 UTC. Later coverage was excluded.

The original October 2 Culpium report is identified by contemporaneous coverage, but a dated original copy suitable for verifying its complete pre-cutoff text was not retrieved; the October 3 independent report is used for the prior-context claim.
The original Intel and Musk X posts could not be opened during research; coverage quoting or describing them is used instead.
research_notes: The pre-cutoff feed record places Bloomberg’s “keep working” headline at 2026-10-07 04:32 UTC, about 17 minutes before the 04:49 UTC cutoff. The direct Bloomberg page was not retrievable; its Yahoo Finance syndication shows the article text but no revision history, so the feed verifies the headline and publication time, not a pre-cutoff snapshot of the full article body. Earlier context includes Intel’s April announcement that it joined Terafab and Musk’s October 3 confirmation of TSMC discussions. No independent report of Tan’s statement was verified as published by the cutoff.
